questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Area of the Parallelogram Spanned by Two Non-Parallel Vectors
questions.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot 4-2\cdot 1 \\  & =6\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,6\,|=6
$$

questions.problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=⟨-1,-2⟩$ and $\text{v}=⟨3,6⟩.$
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ -2 & 6\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ -2 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-1)\cdot 6-3\cdot (-2) \\  & =-6+6 \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,0\,|=0
$$

$$

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

$$

questions.problem:
Determine the area $A$ of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$

questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-2)\cdot 4-5\cdot 3 \\  & =-8-15 \\  & =-23\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,-23\,|=23
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Area of the Parallelogram Spanned by Two Parallel Vectors
questions.worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-\frac{4}{3} & a \\ 7 & -9\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-\frac{4}{3} & a \\ 7 & -9\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-\frac{4}{3})\cdot (-9)-a\cdot 7 \\  & =12-7a\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, setting the expression for the determinant equal to $0$ and solving for $a,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}12-7a & =0 \\ 7a & =12 \\ a & =\frac{12}{7}.\end{aligned}
$$
